title: Spec of a ring map is flat iff the ring map is flat
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ the induced morphism of affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] if and only if $\varphi$ is a flat ring map [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
